title: Merge Plants vs Zombies
description: Fuse matching pea-shooters, sunflowers, and frost plants into super-powered botanical defenders to blast waves of quirky zombies off your lawn.
controls: Drag two identical plants together to evolve a stronger turret and position them in lanes to stop incoming zombies.

zh-CN.title: 合成植物大战僵尸
zh-CN.description: 爆款二合塔防合成植物大战僵尸：拖拽两株相同植物秒变高阶超级射手，满屏豌豆冰瓜轰飞成群呆萌僵尸！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动两株相同等级的植物合体升级，排兵布阵火力全开消灭所有来袭僵尸。
